users.title: Users
users.deactivateBody: They will be immediately signed out and unable to log back in until reactivated.
users.resetPointsBody: This will delete all their challenge submissions, scores, and hint unlocks. This cannot be undone.
users.toastPointsReset: Points reset — all submissions and scores cleared

deployments.removeBody: Permanently remove the "{lab}" deployment record for {username}? This cannot be undone.

apiKeys.revokeBody: Revoke "{name}" owned by {username}? Any integrations using this key will stop working immediately.

assessments.candidateInstructionsPlaceholder: Shown to candidates on the invite page. Markdown supported — explain goals, flag format, report expectations.

assessments.noInvitesYet: No invites yet. Add candidates above.
assessments.revokeInviteBody: This will block {email} from starting or continuing the assessment.

settings.openRegDesc: Allow new users to self-register at /register. Disable to lock down signups.
settings.maintenanceModeDesc: Show a maintenance screen to all non-admin users. Admins see a banner and can still access everything.
settings.maintenanceMessageDesc: Shown to users on the maintenance screen.
settings.maxFlagAttemptsDesc: Maximum wrong flag submissions per challenge (global default). Leave blank for unlimited.
settings.firstBloodDesc: Track and display who was the first solver on each challenge.
settings.dynamicScoringDesc: Points decrease as more players solve a challenge. First blood gets full points.
settings.decayFactorDesc: Multiplier per solve (0.0–1.0). Lower = faster decay. Default 0.9.
settings.minFloorDesc: Points never drop below this percentage of the base value. Default 10%.
settings.freezeScoreboardDesc: Lock the global leaderboard display at this time. New solves still record but won't move rankings.
settings.pythonEditorDesc: Show an in-browser Python scratchpad on Python challenges. Runs entirely in the user's browser via Pyodide (WebAssembly) — nothing reaches the server.
settings.hideLabPortsDesc: Don't reveal a lab's exposed ports anywhere in the UI or API — candidates have to scan for them. Disable this to show port numbers on lab and deployment pages.
settings.brandingDesc: Global platform branding shown on the candidate-facing assessment pages. Individual assessments can override these with their own company name and logo.
settings.companyNameDesc: Displayed on assessment landing pages and the candidate workspace header.
settings.companyLogoUrlDesc: Public URL to a PNG or SVG logo. Displayed next to the company name on assessment pages.
settings.appearanceDesc: Set the default theme for users who have not chosen one themselves. Users can override this from their personal settings.
settings.defaultThemeDesc: Applied to new users and any user who has not explicitly chosen a theme.
settings.defaultLanguageDesc: Applied to new users and any user who has not explicitly chosen a language.
settings.resetDbDesc: Wipe all user activity — submissions, scores, hint unlocks, deployments, and audit logs. Accounts, teams, labs, and challenges are preserved.
settings.restartPlatformDesc: Stops every running lab, then restarts the API, worker, and frontend containers. The platform will be briefly unreachable while it comes back up.
settings.toastDbReset: Database reset — all activity data cleared
settings.resetDbConfirmBody: This will permanently delete ALL submissions, scores, hint unlocks, badges, event registrations, assessment invites & reports, deployments, notifications, sessions, and audit logs. Accounts, teams, labs, challenges, events, and assessment configs are kept. This cannot be undone.
settings.toastPlatformRestarting: Platform restarting — this may take a minute
settings.restartConfirmBody: This stops every running lab, then restarts the API, worker, and frontend containers. The platform — including this page — will be briefly unreachable while it comes back up.
